independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the item trigger rows, the panel insets and the divider.

intent: Show one or several of a set of labelled sections, each under its own trigger

properties.description: Comma-separated values of the open items (an item value is its value attribute, else its index). Setting it opens and closes the items without a change event.
The first value, applied once at connect when no value attribute is present (Base UI defaultValue). Without either, the items open / default-open seed it.
Several items may be open; otherwise opening one closes the others and only the first seeded item opens.
Every item ignores presses and its trigger leaves the tab order.
vertical (default) or horizontal: the item layout, the divider side and which arrow keys move focus.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: change
events.trigger: an item's trigger is pressed and its openchange was not canceled; preventDefault keeps every item as it is

semantics.role: none (each trigger is role=button inside a role=heading header; each panel is role=region)

keyboard.action: open or close that item (single mode: opening closes the others)
move focus to the next / previous enabled trigger, wrapping
move focus to the first / last enabled trigger

content.children: ui-collapsible items (preset: label and content; or their trigger and panel parts). Other children are left as they are and take no part in the value.

constraints: The accordion owns the items' open state: change the accordion's value, not an item's open, from script.
Without value or default-value, the items' open / default-open attributes seed the first value (only the first open one in single mode).
Every trigger stays in the tab order; arrow keys only move focus (APG accordion), they do not open items.
Headers are role=heading aria-level=3 elements in both renderers (Base UI renders an h3; render changes it).

avoidWhen.when: Peer views where exactly one is always shown, switched from a row of labels.
avoidWhen.reason: Tabs keep one panel visible and name every view in one list.

avoidWhen.when: Content the user must compare side by side.
avoidWhen.reason: An accordion hides the sections it closes; lay them out in a collection instead.

nodes.summary: One item: a ui-collapsible child (data-open / data-closed, data-disabled, data-index). Base UI Accordion.Item.
The heading around an item's trigger (role=heading, aria-level 3; data-open, data-disabled, data-index). Base UI Accordion.Header.
